from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from memory.session_manager import get_memory_store

stats_router = APIRouter()

@stats_router.get("/api/stats")
def get_stats():
    memory_store = get_memory_store()
    active_tasks = len([task for task in memory_store.tasks if task.status == 'active'])
    memory_notes_count = len(memory_store.notes)
    server_status = 'online'
    return JSONResponse(content={'active_tasks': active_tasks, 'memory_notes_count': memory_notes_count, 'server_status': server_status}, media_type='application/json')
